name: Zscaler - Identify Hosts with Anomalous Firewall Denies
xql_query:
dataset = zscaler_nssfwlog_raw
| filter act != "Allow"
// One row per external source: an attack is a burst from one address (brute force
// sends 20-60), while routine denies (inbound probes, VPN auth typos) come from a
// different address each time or a user's own home IP a few times a day.
| comp count() as total_denies, count_distinct(dpt) as distinct_ports,
       values(dst) as destination_ips, values(dpt) as destination_ports,
       values(cs2) as rule_labels, values(cs6) as threat_names,
       values(cs4) as destination_countries, min(rt) as first_deny, max(rt) as last_deny
       by src, suser, deviceHostName
| filter total_denies >= 15
| alter source_ip = src, threat_name = arrayindex(threat_names, 0),
        destination_port = arrayindex(destination_ports, 0),
        destination_ip = arrayindex(destination_ips, 0)
| fields source_ip, suser, deviceHostName, total_denies, distinct_ports, destination_ip,
         destination_port, destination_ips, rule_labels, threat_name, threat_names,
         destination_countries, first_deny, last_deny
| sort desc total_denies
description: 15 or more Zscaler cloud-firewall denies from one source address in an hour: a brute-force or scan burst against the user's host or the VPN gateway.
alert_name: Zscaler - Identify Hosts with Anomalous Firewall Denies
